cues.zh: 还在飞速运转，我知道那才是真正的他。
cues.en: was working overtime and I knew that that was him.

cues.zh: 除了这些，他就只剩下一副空壳了。
cues.en: Other than that, he's just a shadow.
(dramatic piano music)

cues.zh: - [采访者] 今天，Clive 的妹妹 Adele
cues.en: - [Interviewer] Today, Clive's sister Adele
has come to see him.

cues.zh: - 我们以前常带他的孩子们来看他，
cues.en: - And we used to take his children to see him,

cues.zh: 但他过去总是变得极具攻击性。
cues.en: but he used to get very aggressive.
He was very angry.
You know, there was one occasion
when I went to see him on my own

cues.zh: 当我自报家门时，他几乎要对我动手。
cues.en: and when I said who I was, he attacked me almost.

cues.zh: 你知道，非常凶狠地抓住了我。
cues.en: You know, grabbed hold of me very aggressively.

cues.zh: 后来工作人员进来，才算平息了局面。
cues.en: And the staff came in and sort of calmed it down.

cues.zh: 但他记得我年轻时的样子。
cues.en: But he remembered me when I was younger.

cues.zh: 他刚才说：“不行，你太老了。”
cues.en: He just said, "No, you're too old."

cues.zh: - 那就是我们四个了，对吧？
cues.en: - That's all four of us, is it?
- That's what Adele looked like.

cues.zh: 你们觉得自己那时候多大？
cues.en: How old do you think you all were then?
- I looked about 10 or 11.

cues.zh: - [阿黛尔] 其实我觉得我那时候大概四岁。
cues.en: - [Adele] I think I'm about four there, actually.
- [Deborah] About four.

cues.zh: - 对，所以你那时候大概9岁或10岁。
cues.en: - Yeah, so you're about 9 or 10 there.

cues.zh: - 杰夫跟我们比起来是不是显得特别高大？
cues.en: - And doesn't Jeff look enormous compared with us?
- [Deborah] And he went off to sea
when he was 15, didn't he?

cues.zh: - [阿黛尔] 是的，他去了商船队。
cues.en: - [Adele] Yes, he went to the Merchant Navy.

cues.zh: - [克莱夫] 是啊，但跟飞机比起来
cues.en: - [Clive] Yeah, but the ships travel really quite slowly

cues.zh: 船走得其实挺慢的，对吧？
cues.en: compared with the aircraft, don't they?
- Oh, very slowly, yes.
I used to go and visit him.
I found it just so difficult.

cues.zh: 而且跟他说话一点也不容易。
cues.en: And not easy to talk to him at all.
My husband who'd got no connection with him
found it much easier.

cues.zh: 他能聊些完全不相关的事
cues.en: He could talk about things that were totally irrelevant
and quite happily carry on a conversation with him.
But I have always found that
an extremely difficult thing to do.
- [Clive] Oh, a shame.
- [Adele] It's been lovely to see you.
- (indistinct) see me.
- See you. All right.
- Oh, wonderful.
- [Adele] Bye-bye for now.
You stay there and I'll...
- Will you open the door?
- [Adele] I will.
- Are you going? - I'm going.
- [Clive] Oh, shame. (laughs)
- Bye-bye.
- [Clive] Back at the speed of light, please.
- [Adele] I'll do my best. Bye.
- Isn't she wonderful? (chuckles)

cues.zh: - [采访者] 你记得Adele坐在你旁边吗？
cues.en: - [Interviewer] Do you remember Adele sitting next to you?
- No.

cues.zh: - [采访者] 你记得她穿什么吗？
cues.en: - [Interviewer] Can you remember what she was wearing?
- No. Never seen her.

cues.zh: 你们是我见到的第一批人类，你们三个。
cues.en: You're the first human beings I've seen, three of you.
Two men and one lady.

cues.zh: 这是我生病以来见到的第一批人。
cues.en: The first people I've seen since I've been ill.
No difference in day and night.

cues.zh: 什么念头都没有，也没有梦。
cues.en: No thoughts at all. No dreams.

cues.zh: 白天和黑夜都一样，一片空白。
cues.en: Day and night the same. Blank.
Precisely like death.
- [Interviewer] Is it very hard?
- No.
It's exactly the same as being dead,
which is not difficult, is it?
Being dead is easy.
You don't do anything at all.

cues.zh: 死了之后什么也做不了。
cues.en: You can't do anything when you're dead.

cues.zh: 一直都是这样，一模一样。
cues.en: It's been the same. Exactly.

cues.zh: - [采访者] 你会怀念过去的生活吗？
cues.en: - [Interviewer] Do you miss your old life?

cues.zh: - 会，但我从来没有清醒地意识到自己在想这件事。
cues.en: - Yes, though I've never been conscious to think that.

cues.zh: 所以我从来没觉得无聊或难过。
cues.en: So I've never been bored or upset.
Never been anything at all.
Exactly the same as death.
No dreams even.
Day and night the same.

cues.zh: - [采访者] 你怀念过去的生活时，
cues.en: - [Interviewer] When you miss your old life,

cues.zh: 你会说：“是的，我怀念过去的生活。”
cues.en: you say, "Yes, I miss my old life."
What do you miss?

cues.zh: 我既是音乐家，也曾深爱过一个人。
cues.en: - The fact that I was a musician and in love.

cues.zh: 他会说：“你知道那是什么感觉吗？”
cues.en: - He'll say things like, "Do you know what it's like?"
And that's really dangerous 'cause,

cues.zh: 我还真回答过一次“知道”。
cues.en: I actually did, I said yes once

cues.zh: 因为我那时就是逢人便说“好”。（笑）
cues.en: 'cause I was just saying yes (chuckles).
That was disastrous.

cues.zh: 从那以后，我再也没这么说过。
cues.en: I've never said that again since.
- [Interviewer] Why?

cues.zh: - 因为他说：“你不知道那是什么感觉。
cues.en: - Because he says, "You don't know what it's like.
How do you know?"

cues.zh: 当然，他说得对，不是吗？（笑）
cues.en: And of course, he's right, isn't he? (chuckles)

cues.zh: 所以，你根本不可能知道那是什么感觉。
cues.en: So, there's no way you're gonna know what it's like.
- [Interviewer] He's still got some fight in him.
- Oh yeah, yeah.
But that's the thing.

cues.zh: 他大概四分之三的性格
cues.en: Probably three-quarters of his personality
is still there functioning normally.

cues.zh: 他会分析正在发生的事。
cues.en: He will analyze what's happening.
He'll say, "Well, the doctors must be
very interested in this.

cues.zh: 这是一个非常罕见的病例。”
cues.en: It's a very unusual case."

cues.zh: 他一次又一次地把事情想通，
cues.en: He worked it all out over and over again
because he doesn't really remember

cues.zh: 自己一个小时前才刚想通过。
cues.en: that he worked it out an hour ago.
(leaves rustling)
(bright piano music)
(Clive blowing out air)
- [Deborah] (laughs) Woohoo!

cues.zh: - Deborah 为爸爸做的事，比任何人都多。
cues.en: - Deborah's done more for Dad than any other single person.

cues.zh: 我非常怀疑自己能不能为他做到那一步。
cues.en: I very much doubt that I could have done that for him.
And that's hard.
That's very hard.
I think I'd have given up.

cues.zh: - 你看到了吗？ - 看到啦。
cues.en: - Do you see that? - Yes.

cues.zh: - [Interviewer] 你上次见你父亲是什么时候？
cues.en: - [Interviewer] When did you last see your father?
- [Deborah] Oh, it's revolting.
- I wouldn't like to say when it was
'cause I really can't remember.
It's too hard.

cues.zh: 结婚时我曾想让他牵我走上红毯，
cues.en: I wanted him to walk me down the aisle
when I got married and he couldn't.

cues.zh: 我想让他知道他抱孙子了，
cues.en: I wanted him to know that I'd had his grandchildren
and he couldn't.
So he's a lovely person.
He's Clive now.
Dad's gone.
(electric razor buzzing)

cues.zh: - 考虑到他仍是世上失忆最严重的人之一，
cues.en: - Considering he's still one of the most amnesic people
in the world, he's pretty peaceful,

cues.zh: 即使他不知道自己身在何处，
cues.en: considering he doesn't know where he is

cues.zh: 不知道现在是哪一个世纪、那天早上几点起床，
cues.en: or what century it is or what time he got up that morning

cues.zh: 也不知道自己住在这里。
cues.en: or that he's in a place where he lives.
Considering all of that,
his state of mind is extraordinarily calm,

cues.zh: 快乐、满足，而且很像他自己。
cues.en: happy, content, and very much himself.
He's himself.

cues.zh: - [采访者] 如果现在你可以做任何事，
cues.en: - [Interviewer] If you could do anything now,

cues.zh: 如果可以自由选择，接下来你想做什么？
cues.en: if you had free choice, what would you do next?

cues.zh: - 哦，我想来杯金汤力。（轻笑）
cues.en: - Oh, a gin and tonic, I think. (chuckles)
With a cigarette.

cues.zh: 然后，当然是等待时间悄然流逝、消失，
cues.en: Then, of course, waiting for time to elude and disappear
and her arrival.
(bright piano music)
(gentle music)

cues.zh: - [男子] 每侧脸上都有二十多块肌肉。
cues.en: - [Man] There are 20-some muscles on each side of the face.

cues.zh: 一个微笑能表达出许许多多不同的含义。
cues.en: So many, many possibilities of expression in the smile.

cues.zh: 有人说笑容会从眼神里透出来，确实如此
cues.en: Some people say you smile with your eyes and this is true

cues.zh: 因为那些细微的变化和眼角的皱纹，
cues.en: because with these minute changes and the wrinkles,

cues.zh: 也许是浅浅一笑，也许是大笑。
cues.en: maybe have a soft smile or a big laugh.

cues.zh: 所以我们时刻都在运用面部表情。
cues.en: So we use the face all the time.
(man speaking in foreign language)
